import AlgebraicJacobian
open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry Limits
namespace Audit
universe u

-- Step 1: tilde M is ALWAYS quasi-coherent (mathlib presentationTilde + Presentation.isQuasicoherent).
theorem tilde_isQuasicoherent {R : CommRingCat.{u}} (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) :
    (tilde M).IsQuasicoherent :=
  (AlgebraicGeometry.presentationTilde.{u} M Set.univ (by simp) _
    (Submodule.span_eq _)).isQuasicoherent

-- Step 2: over an AFFINE base, a binary product of quasi-coherent modules is quasi-coherent.
-- Route: A ≅ tilde ΓA, B ≅ tilde ΓB (isIso_fromTildeΓ), tilde preserves finite limits
-- (tildePreservesFiniteLimits, already in the tree), so A ⨯ B ≅ tilde (ΓA ⨯ ΓB), qcoh by step 1.
example {R : CommRingCat.{u}} (A B : (Spec R).Modules)
    (hA : A.IsQuasicoherent) (hB : B.IsQuasicoherent) :
    (Limits.prod A B).IsQuasicoherent := by
  haveI := hA; haveI := hB
  haveI : PreservesFiniteLimits (tilde.functor R) := tildePreservesFiniteLimits
  let eA : (tilde.functor R).obj (Γ(A, ⊤) : ModuleCat.{u} R) ≅ A := asIso A.fromTildeΓ
  let eB : (tilde.functor R).obj (Γ(B, ⊤) : ModuleCat.{u} R) ≅ B := asIso B.fromTildeΓ
  have e : (tilde.functor R).obj (Limits.prod (Γ(A, ⊤) : ModuleCat.{u} R) Γ(B, ⊤))
      ≅ Limits.prod A B :=
    Limits.PreservesLimitPair.iso (tilde.functor R) _ _ ≪≫ Limits.prod.mapIso eA eB
  exact (tilde_isQuasicoherent _).prop_of_iso e |>.elim
end Audit
EOF

The file's header had prescribed a stalk route at 100–150 LOC; none of that machinery was needed, and I corrected the header rather than leave it to mislead the next session.

Also replaced the flat-pullback probe, which my own de-instancing had made *vacuously clean* — it measured the identity morphism, where a cheaper clean path appeared.
